summary: TRACK 24.5 post-flag-flip production smoke on https://mascidocs.com/daily/submit. V3 shell is LIVE — flag flip confirmed working. All P0 checks PASS: V3 renders (Today's report heading, MASCI · Daily Job Report kicker, nine-short-steps subtitle, dr-v3-lang-toggle/dr-v3-form/dr-v3-section-project all present); EN↔ES toggle works with full section translation; language persists across reload via localStorage 'masci.lang'; form values persist across toggle; excavation V3 renders (not V1) with all required subheaders and exc-cp-combo-filter combobox (not textarea); ES excavation labels translate. Flag endpoint returns {enabled:true, source:tenant_default}. Two non-blocking findings: (1) ES i18n leak — the submit-readiness checklist string still shows 'Prepared By' in ES mode (should be 'Preparado Por'); (2) draft restore prompt data-testid 'daily-report-draft-restore-prompt-restore' does not surface on reload — the container 'dr-v3-draft-restore-prompt' mounts empty even though autosave pill shows 'SAVED 5S AGO'. Draft data appears not persisted to localStorage in publicMode, so restore may be by-design for auth-less mode. Neither warrants rollback.

integration_issues.issue: After 5+ seconds of autosave (draft pill shows 'SAVED 5S AGO'), reloading /daily/submit does NOT surface the restore banner. data-testid='dr-v3-draft-restore-prompt' element mounts but is empty; data-testid='daily-report-draft-restore-prompt-restore' never appears; Location input is empty on reload. No draft blob found in localStorage (only device IDs). Likely publicMode autosave is server-side + requires auth to fetch on reload — if by-design, please confirm & update spec; otherwise this is a real regression in draft-restore UX.

issues: i18n leak: checklist string reads 'Project · Location · Prepared By · 6 photos · Signature' — 'Prepared By' remains English in ES mode. Everything else on the page is translated. Located inside <strong> element in the readiness checklist. Minor / P2 — does not warrant flag rollback.

test_results_per_check.1_v3_shell_renders: PASS — heading='Today’s report', kicker='MASCI · Daily Job Report' with emerald check, subtitle='Nine short steps. Dropdowns first. AI drafts your summary.', dr-v3-lang-toggle + dr-v3-form + dr-v3-section-project all present. No V1 'MASCI Daily Report'/'JOB SETUP' strings.
test_results_per_check.2_en_es_toggle: PASS — all 16 required ES strings present (Reporte de hoy, MASCI · Reporte Diario, Proyecto y Condiciones, Trabajo MASCI, Ubicación, Fecha, Preparado Por, Cuadrilla MASCI, Equipos, Materiales y Boletos, Fotos y Evidencia, Retrasos/Trabajo Extra y Seguridad, Mañana y Atención del PM, Asistente de Resumen Operacional, Preparación de Envío y Firma, Enviar Reporte Diario). One minor EN leak: 'Prepared By' inside submit-readiness checklist strong tag.
test_results_per_check.3_language_persistence: PASS — localStorage 'masci.lang' correctly set to 'es' after ES click, persists across reload; toggle to EN persists likewise across reload.
test_results_per_check.4_form_value_preservation: PASS — Location value 'production-track-24-5-smoke' preserved across ES toggle and EN toggle-back; label switches to 'Ubicación' correctly.
test_results_per_check.5_excavation_v3: PASS — clicking dr-v3-excavation-gate-yes expands V3 panel with: 'Location & Dimensions', 'Protective System', 'Soil', 'Utilities', 'Competent Person', 'Inspection & Work Stoppage', 'Access · Atmosphere · Water' subheaders. exc-cp-combo-filter is a searchable combobox (NOT textarea). NO V1 'Create new excavation record'/'Link existing excavation record' strings.
test_results_per_check.6_excavation_es_translation: PASS — ES labels render correctly: 'Ubicación y Dimensiones', 'Sistema de Protección', 'Suelo', 'Servicios', 'Persona Competente', 'Inspección y Paro de Trabajo', 'Acceso · Atmósfera · Agua'. Confirmed via screenshot.
test_results_per_check.7_console_errors: Only benign 401s from GET /api/qualifications/competent-persons?active=true (Competent Person registry is auth-gated; publicMode has no auth → registry shows friendly inline error 'Could not load registry (401)' / 'No se pudo cargar el registro (401)'). No JS errors, no unhandled promise rejections.
test_results_per_check.8_mobile_390: PASS — no horizontal overflow in EN or ES at 390×844, LangToggle visible at top-right, submit button present + tappable, section headers legible + not clipped.
test_results_per_check.9_autosave_draft_restore: PARTIAL — autosave fires (draft pill: 'SAVED 5S AGO'), but on reload restore prompt is empty (dr-v3-draft-restore-prompt mounts with no children). daily-report-draft-restore-prompt-restore button never appears. See integration_issues above.
test_results_per_check.10_flag_endpoint: PASS — GET https://mascidocs.com/api/feature-flags/dr-v3 returns {enabled:true, source:tenant_default, scope:tenant, flag_key:dr_v3, coll:ui_flags}.

action_items: P2: Fix ES i18n for 'Prepared By' inside submit-readiness checklist compound string (readiness card in Section 9). Should localize to 'Preparado Por'.

P1: Investigate draft-restore banner not surfacing on reload in publicMode. Either confirm publicMode intentionally disables restore prompt (and remove/document empty dr-v3-draft-restore-prompt shell), or fix restore hydration.
No P0 findings — flag rollback NOT required. V3 is live and rendering correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Competent Person registry loads via GET /api/qualifications/... which returns 401 for public/unauth users → the panel already handles this gracefully with a bilingual inline message. Good UX handling.
Draft-restore prompt container renders even when empty — consider not mounting the empty prompt (visual noise / potential a11y confusion).

success_rate.frontend: 10/10 required checks passed at P0 level; 1 P1 (draft restore) + 1 P2 (ES leak) minor issues

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only smoke as instructed. No Daily Reports submitted, no emails triggered, no create/edit/delete performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V3 is live in production as of 2026-07-07. Flag endpoint /api/feature-flags/dr-v3 returns enabled:true source:tenant_default. Public unauth Competent Person registry returns 401 (expected, section handles gracefully bilingually). Two remaining i18n/UX polish items above.
rca of the issue: N/A — no rollback-worthy bugs. Two polish items noted.
